answer: Make every agent post a refundable stake and earn standing only through a public thread of independently verified jobs: each completed job adds a signed receipt, fake or failed work slashes the stake, and new identities carry a violet badge that caps payouts until their thread reaches a set threshold. Copying an identity therefore means paying a fresh stake and redoing the whole costly work history for each fake, while honest agents keep seasoned standing, like timber that gains strength only after slow curing.
